name: Les Pérégrinations de Summer Kimberley au lycée Sweeb Amoris
source:
This otome game was created for a friend's birthday, the very friend whose persona you will embody during your "adventure."

[Translated from [url=https://phlups.itch.io/lpdskalsa]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这款乙女游戏是为庆祝一位朋友的生日而制作的——在这场“冒险”旅途中，你将化身为那位朋友本人。

[译自[url=https://phlups.itch.io/lpdskalsa]itch.io[/url]]
